IB CS · SL

Unit 3: Data Structures & Logic

Theme B2.2 | 3 Weeks (9 Lessons)

Unit overview

How do we organise data so we can find it quickly and use it efficiently?

This unit covers 4 IB Computer Science sub-topics: B2.2.1, B2.2.2, B2.2.3, and B2.2.4.

The focus areas are Static vs Dynamic data structures, Arrays and Lists, Stacks (LIFO), and Queues (FIFO).

Coverage

  • B2.2.1 Static vs Dynamic data structures
  • B2.2.2 Arrays and Lists
  • B2.2.3 Stacks (LIFO)
  • B2.2.4 Queues (FIFO)

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
B2.2.1 Static vs Dynamic data structures Compare static and dynamic data structures.
B2.2.2 Arrays and Lists Construct programs that apply arrays and Lists.
B2.2.3 Stacks (LIFO) Explain the concept of a stack.
B2.2.4 Queues (FIFO) Explain the concept of a queue.
